title: A Bayesian Approach to Segmentation with Noisy Labels via Spatially Correlated Distributions
mechanism: Variational inference over spatially correlated label errors via a latent Gaussian field with KMS-structured covariance (ECCD).
adaptation: Model crack labels as truth with flips correlated along the crack direction (correlation length about 10 px), covering both jitter and omission.
min_experiment: Arm: house + ECCD loss on crack. Baseline: house. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill if < house + 0.008. About 10 GPU-h plus a week of code.
evidence: R: spatial correlation modelling clearly helps on several tasks; lung segmentation near clean-label level at moderate noise (abstract).
